narrative.intro: Northrop Grumman Systems obligated $2.9B in FY2026 to date. Northrop Grumman Systems received 2 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $1.4B. Northrop Grumman Systems obligations are up 124.5% year over year. Annual obligations show fluctuation: FY21 was $1.1B, FY22 was $2B, FY23 was $2.9B, FY24 was $3.5B, FY25 was $1.3B, and FY26 is $2.9B to date. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the largest market for Northrop Grumman Systems in FY2026 to date at $2.9B. Engineering Services is a secondary market at $1.2M. The page notes that figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, and current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). This profile summarizes where Northrop Grumman Systems is concentrating federal sales and how the current fiscal year compares to recent years.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Northrop Grumman Systems revenues by market?
sections.body: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the dominant market for Northrop Grumman Systems at $2.9B in FY2026 to date. Engineering Services accounts for $1.2M, indicating a strong concentration in aerospace and defense manufacturing rather than services.

sections.heading: How does FY2026 performance compare with recent years?
sections.body: Northrop Grumman Systems obligated $2.9B in FY26 to date, matching FY23 total obligations of $2.9B and exceeding FY25 obligations of $1.3B. Northrop Grumman Systems obligations are up 124.5% year over year, reflecting a sizable rebound from the prior fiscal year.
